description: Parking relais is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France. Base being consolidated listing relay parks on French territory. Data downloaded daily from data.gouv.fr, cut on the territory of the Hauts-de-France region, and published by Géo2France. GEMET - INSPIRE themes, version 1.0: Transport networks. Territories:. GEMET: parking lot. Territorial granularity: Point of interest. Coverage: Géo2France. The portal shows the English title as "Relay parking" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France. Its keywords include parc-de-stationnement, reseaux-de-transport, point-dinteret, donnee-ouverte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
